title: What Microplastics Are Doing to the Brain, Body, and Reproductive Systems
summary: A FoundMyFitness episode on how microplastics and associated chemicals such as BPA and PFAS accumulate in the body, including the brain and reproductive systems. It also discusses ways to reduce exposure.
why: Mentioned occasionally as an episode on environmental toxins in food and water, though one commenter lumps it in with unregulated quackery.

quote.text: just did a great episode on PFAS, microplastics, and other environmental toxins in food and water.
